description_en: Modifies the basic properties of an AD office network (formerly workspace), such as the office network name and the domain name of the enterprise AD subdomain
description_zh: 修改AD办公网络（原工作区）的基本属性，例如办公网络名称、企业AD子域的域名等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-ad-connector-office-site --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-3633530000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyADConnectorOfficeSite

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD. The same domain name can be registered only once
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD的域名。相同的域名只能注册一次
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The username of the domain administrator. The username can be up to 64 characters in length.

Use sAMAccountName for the username. Do not use userPrincipalName
parameters.help_zh:
域管理员的用户名。最长支持64个英文字符。

用户名请使用sAMAccountName，不能使用userPrincipalName
parameters.name: domain_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the domain administrator. The password can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 域管理员的用户密码。最长支持64个英文字符
parameters.name: domain_password

parameters.help_en: The office network name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD subdomain
parameters.name: sub_domain_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA)
parameters.name: mfa_enabled

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the DNS server corresponding to the enterprise AD. Currently, only one IP address can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD对应DNS的IP地址。目前仅支持设置一个
parameters.name: dns_address

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the enterprise AD subdomain. Currently, only one address can be specified. If `SubDomainName` is specified but this parameter is not, the subdomain DNS defaults to the same value as the parent domain
parameters.help_zh: 企业AD子域的DNS地址。目前仅支持设置一个。如果设置了`SubDomainName`，而未设置此参数，则默认为子域DNS和父域的一致
parameters.name: sub_domain_dns_address

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the domain controller. The hostname must comply with Windows hostname naming conventions
parameters.help_zh:
域控主机名。
必须符合Windows主机命名规范
parameters.name: ad_hostname

parameters.help_en: The organizational unit (OU) of the AD domain. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: AD域的组织单元OU。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html获取
parameters.name: ou_name

parameters.help_en: The DNS address of the backup domain controller
parameters.name: backup_dns

parameters.help_en: The hostname of the backup domain controller
parameters.name: backup_dc_hostname
